puzzles.title: The Rime Pillar of Frostmere
puzzles.prompt:
Inscribed upon the spiraling ice pillar in ancient northern runes:

'I fly without wings, I bite without teeth,
I build up the glacier, I cover the heath.
I howl without throat on the darkest of nights,
Yet wither to water when sun shows its lights.
What am I?'
puzzles.question: What answer satisfies the icy pillar?
puzzles.customAnswerLabel: Speak your word to the frost pillar:
clueJournalIds: The Rime Riddle of the Spire
puzzles.knownAnswerLabel: Answer with the scholar's riddle: "The blizzard itself."
puzzles.deductionHint: Think of what howls across the glacier peaks.
puzzles.deductionFailText: The runic words remain cold and silent. The frosty air stings your cheeks.
puzzles.wrongAnswerText: A burst of bitter frost puffs from the stone, freezing your breath.

transcript.speaker: The Rime Pillar
transcript.text: The blue runes flare with brilliant cold fire. An inner niche slides open in the ice, presenting the Silver Key of the Winter Spire!

addJournalChronicle.title: The Frost Pillar Solved
addJournalChronicle.text: Spoke the riddle of the blizzard. The pillar granted the Silver Key to the Spire's inner arcanum.

puzzles.title: The Triad of Star-Keys
puzzles.prompt:
Three granite altars stand before the dormant Frost Wyrm Vyr. Each pedestal is etched with a celestial glyph:
1. The Peak of Dawn (Alpha)
2. The Spire of Rime (Beta)
3. The Barrow of Old (Gamma)
When all three Star-Keys are fitted into their sockets, the ancestral seal of High King Valen will either solidify the binding forever or awaken the dragon for mortal combat.
puzzles.question: Will you place the three Star-Keys into the ancient pedestals?
puzzles.customAnswerLabel: Chant the words of the Star-Father:
puzzles.knownAnswerLabel: Invoke Torvald's name and insert the three Star-Keys.
puzzles.deductionHint: Recall the teachings in the Frostmere Arcanum.
puzzles.deductionFailText: You hesitate before the cosmic weight of the dragon pedestals.
puzzles.wrongAnswerText: The pedestals rumble with hollow discordance.

transcript.speaker: Mount Wyrmfang
transcript.text: The three star-keys lock into place with a thunderclap. Blazing columns of celestial light erupt into the storm clouds, shattering the Wyrm's shackles!

addJournalChronicle.title: The Dragon Unbound
addJournalChronicle.text: Inserted the three Star-Keys upon Mount Wyrmfang. Vyr the Frost Wyrm awakens!
